2023-05-04 Burrow (The), Rathangan, Ireland

Share: 

Local Start Time ??:?? / End Time ??:??

Info & Setlist | Venue

Bruce visits The Burrow pub in Rathangan, County Kildare (where the Irish part of his family originated), for a pint, and leads the patrons in a singalong of the first verse of "My Hometown". Later the same day, Bruce visited former Pogues singer Shane MacGowan's home in Dublin.
